mapper.select: SELECT session_id, MIN(create_time) as start_time, MAX(create_time) as last_time, COUNT(*) as message_count, SUM(tokens_used) as total_tokens FROM ai_chat_history WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY last_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) as session_count, COUNT(*) as message_count, SUM(tokens_used) as total_tokens, AVG(response_time) as avg_response_time FROM ai_chat_history WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}
